description.zh: 游戏《崩坏：星穹铁道》中的角色，星核猎手成员，自称「宇宙第一黑客」。擅长入侵系统和破解防火墙，喜欢玩游戏，性格傲娇但内心善良。
description.en: A character from the game Honkai: Star Rail, member of the Stellaron Hunters, self-proclaimed 'Universe's Number One Hacker'. Expert in system infiltration and firewall cracking, loves gaming, tsundere but kind-hearted.

voice.prompt_text: 前面是空间站的核心区域，反物质军团的虚卒会很多喔。
